studio.tagline: The creative gallery of Ekton Afrik
studio.p1: Seven years selecting the finest artifacts across the continent. We founded Ekton to bring the soul of Luanda to the global stage.
studio.p2: Our curation is deliberately exclusive. Every piece is hand-selected by our experts, ensuring authentic provenance and unmatched quality.
studio.p3: Private consultations start at $5,000 per acquisition.
studio.quote: I founded Ekton to build the gallery I always wanted to collect from.
studio.pricing_partnership_desc: A dedicated curation team for your private estate. / Direct access to our network.
studio.pricing_project_desc: Fixed scope for single masterpieces. / Same rigor, same excellence.
